axioms.name: horowitz_energies_empirical
axioms.note: empirical (Horowitz, ISSCC 2014, 45nm-class): 32b FP multiply 3.7 pJ, 32b add 0.1 pJ, 32b SRAM read 5 pJ, 32b DRAM read 640 pJ

axioms.name: crossbar_model_empirical
axioms.note: empirical/illustrative: analog crossbar cell compute ~ 0.2 pJ per MAC-equivalent; DAC/ADC conversion ~ 370 pJ each (converter overhead is the known crossbar limitation)

axioms.name: analog_offset_model_empirical
axioms.note: illustrative: a physical analog integrator holds a fixed offset error floor of 1/1000

axioms.name: noise_bernoulli_empirical
axioms.note: empirical: a noisy physical bit source samples independent Bernoulli trials (stochastic computing premise)

axioms.name: ising_relaxation_empirical
axioms.note: empirical: a physical Ising system relaxes preferentially toward low-energy configurations (annealing premise)

axioms.name: physical_church_turing
axioms.note: premise (extended Church-Turing thesis): physical systems are efficiently simulable by digital computers, so physical isomorphisms change constants and latency, not complexity classes; the quantum case (BQP vs BPP) remains OPEN and is not claimed

lemmas.name: break_even_symbolic
lemmas.gap: requires ring/field_simp/linarith (Mathlib) or a manual calc with positivity side-goals; symbolic form of the break-even computation verified concretely in scripts/column3/01_crossbar_break_even.py

lemmas.name: euler_error_general
lemmas.gap: requires field_simp + ring with ℕ-to-ℚ cast bookkeeping (Mathlib) or a manual calc; general form of the error identity checked for M = 1..20 in scripts/column3/04_analog_ode.py

lemmas.name: stochastic_n_required
lemmas.gap: requires linarith/field_simp over ℚ with positivity (Mathlib) or manual cross-multiplication; this is the MINIMALITY claim for the stream length (equality instance proved in chebyshev_2500)
